activity_summary: The court rolls lay in order on the trestle, and each one carried Larkham's small sign in the corner. The pen was wiped. This is the end of the pass.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood at the trestle and did not take a roll up.

entities.name: Humphrey Larkham
entities.context: Had laid them in order and wiped the pen.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Was still in the room, and had already gone on.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Was by the ink, which was no longer needed.

entities.name: Romeo and Juliet
entities.context: Mentioned in The rolls in a row

facets.activity: Saw the court rolls laid in order and signed
